spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: Zythan casts one of the following spells, using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 18}).

trait.name: Battlemage
entries: Being within 5 feet of a hostile creature doesn't impose disadvantage on Zythan's ranged attack rolls.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: Zythan has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Zythan makes three Dagger or Arcane Burst attacks.

action.name: Dagger
entries: {@atk mw,rw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. {@h}4 ({@damage 1d4 + 2}) piercing damage.

action.name: Arcane Burst
entries: {@atk rs} {@hit 10} to hit, range 120 ft., one target. {@h}27 ({@damage 4d10 + 5}) radiant damage.

action.name: Spirit Fissure {@recharge 4}
entries: Zythan causes a disruption in arcane energies in a 300-foot line that is 5 feet wide. Each creature in the line must make a {@dc 18} Constitution saving throw, taking 65 ({@damage 10d12}) radiant damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

reaction.name: Portent (3/Day)
entries: As a reaction to a creature Zythan can see making an attack roll, a saving throw, or an ability check, Zythan rolls a {@dice d20} and chooses whether to use that roll in place of the original roll.
